assets/.why: app SVG icon bundled via resources.qrc

bin/.why: build, install, and offscreen selftest shell wrappers

build-harness/.why: generated qmake build output for QML harness; do not edit

build-tests/.why: generated qmake build output for unit tests; do not edit

graft/.why: regenerable graft repo-map cache; rebuild via graft build

install.sh.why: idempotent per-user installer and desktop entry generator

levele.pro.why: qmake project manifest listing all C++ sources and headers

qml/.why: Qt Quick 6 screens wired to Studio and Theme properties

qml/ui/.why: custom-painted Basic-style controls using theme tokens and a11y

resources.qrc.why: Qt resource manifest embedding all QML files and assets

src/.why: C++17 Qt Quick app core; data, rendering, and state

src/canvasitem.cpp.why: canvas hit-testing, gestures, zoom/pan, and inline text; subtle invariants

src/exporter.cpp.why: threaded PNG/PDF/GIF export, atomic writes, bounded caches; subtle concurrency

src/portalfilechooser.cpp.why: async D-Bus portal file chooser with Qt fallback

src/studio.cpp.why: central controller: undo, trash, locks, async exports, persistence; complex

src/theme.cpp.why: Omarchy/Hyprland theme loader, WCAG contrast, live socket reload

tests/.why: headless Qt unit tests and WCAG contrast checker

tests/qml-harness/.why: offscreen QML acceptance harness compiling app sources directly
